words.df: A polite way to say that food needs a little more seasoning, offered as gentle feedback.

words.p: /ˌɪts ə ˌlɪtəl ˌtu ˈsɔlti fɔɹ mi/

A planned schedule for a trip, listing where you will go, when you will arrive, and what you will do.
